newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd meets Syrian leaders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd meets Syrian leaders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd has held talks with Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara in the Saudi capital Riyadh, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said late on Sunday.
It said Khaddam delivered a letter from Syrian President Hafez al-Assad to the Saudi king.
The talks, held at Yamamah Palace, focused on issues of mutual concern and the latest developments in Arab and Islamic affairs, SPA said. Khaddam and Shara arrived in Saudi Arabia earlier on Sunday.
The two countries have warm ties.
